title: merge --review-record runs lane-lint on the reviewed head and refuses the record on FAIL
why: A review record posted on a head that fails the lane's own checks sends a red PR to the batch, and CI then turns the batch red.
note: Topic merge-tool. Replaces step record-push-runs-catalog-check: merge --lane-lint already runs the hook catalog check, so the gap is that the record post runs no lane-lint (coordinator, 19:43 CST Nov 7). Incident: #1687 got a review record and went to runner 8 with the hook catalog check red. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was session_013NEJKz26y1pT4XskPQbQbz).
